request.test_input_summary: Controlled screenshot request for https://example.com with full_page=false.

assertions.description: screenshot is valid base64 and decodes to bytes beginning with the PNG signature 89504e470d0a1a0a

limitations: This is one timestamped observation of one endpoint invocation.
The observation does not establish that x402engine always returns a contract-invalid artefact.
The observation does not establish that the provider as a whole is unsafe or untrustworthy.
The returned screenshot value failed strict base64 decoding; the retained evidence does not establish its exact alternate representation.
Atinamos did not assess visual fidelity, dimensions or page completeness because the artefact failed the advertised representation check first.
